title: Explicit shot transition
description: Plan three Generations. In Generation 1 a courier approaches a delivery door at night. Generation 2 continues the same uninterrupted action and camera shot as the courier places the parcel down; there is no cut. Generation 3 begins after a deliberate cut and time jump to the next morning, when the recipient discovers the parcel. This new morning setup is not expected to match the previous ending frame.
